articles.headline: Jürgen Klopp named Germany head coach after Julian Nagelsmann departure
articles.description: Jürgen Klopp has been named Germany's head coach, following the national team's disappointing World Cup and the resignation of Julian Nagelsmann.

articles.headline: How Spain won the World Cup without a marquee goal scorer or elite defense
articles.description: Spain's attack and defense didn't have the best players at the World Cup -- but Spain was the best team. How did that happen?

articles.headline: The players who played no minutes at the World Cup -- who were the unlucky few?
articles.description: The World Cup was a time to remember for most, for a handful of players though, their time at the tournament was merely sitting in the best seats in the house.

articles.headline: Colombia backs Néstor Lorenzo with extension after World Cup
articles.description: Néstor Lorenzo will continue as Colombia coach after the national team conceded only one goal in five games at the recent FIFA World Cup.

articles.headline: World Cup grades for all 47 eliminated teams from the tournament
articles.description: With the 2026 World Cup now over, 47 teams have been eliminated, and we're grading each team's run vs. expectations.

articles.headline: Grading FIFA's changes to the World Cup, from expansion to hydration breaks
articles.description: Now that the World Cup is over, let's evaluate all the things that FIFA did differently. Which new features earned A's, and which ones were utter flops?
